knownLimits: AniMadex official export token was not available; data is the pinned public upstream snapshot.
No role thumbnails, original images, or LoRA files were included.
Character-specific terms stay out of ordinary tag search and are returned only through character data.
The existing ordinary-tag favorites format does not persist character selections.
Reference-image reproduction requires an explicitly configured source-image binding; otherwise the result is labeled text_approximation.
Source aspect-ratio matching requires explicit writable width and height bindings; otherwise the workflow dimensions remain fixed.
Translation alignment is optional and depends on the configured AI; unavailable mappings fall back to plain translated text without another AI call.
Local translation stays plain text; long AI translation inputs use sentence or block alignment and may cost more tokens.
